notes.title: Favorite equipment marks
notes.content:
You can now mark equipment as favorite, giving them golden star icons. Favorite equipment will always be sorted first in the inventory.
Fixed a bug where continuing past second level in Trail of Blood wasn't possible.

notes.title: Early Access Update - May 23, 2025
notes.content:
- Added 4 wanted jobs with hand made enemy encounters and anecdotes at Lone Church.
- Cutscenes have specifically marked speakers names now.
- Fixed a bug causing fonts not to render correctly on Linux / Steamdeck.
- It's now easier to escape monsters melee damage with dodge-rolling.
- Opening the inventory will automatically sort all items prioritizing guns and equipment.
- Various side quests fixes.
- We have no budget for a new cover art this week, sorry

notes.title: 4 DAYS TO RELEASE
notes.content:
4 Days Until Early Access Release
Let me speak from my heart in English please -164.628
All I want right now is to cry the loudest tears and smash this laptop I've spent countless hours with tinkering this violent wild west stinker and dozens of other unfinished dead and forgotten games.
I've been asked to post another steam update devlog thing or whatever. Well guess what, since we're way out of that deadline anyway and the dev team is basically on their own - me here ain't gonna try Cozing Up The Audience X Smooching Up The Algorithms Ass. Yes we have a lot of stuff in the game and what not, but me here writing this is filled to the brim with anxiety, so I'll share this instead.  176.566

DON'T WE ALL HATE BEING AT MERCY OF OTHERS
[olist]
 Everyone should be always engaged in 100% productivity output activities.
 Boredom is in deficit and deep inside we all miss those days when there was no fun at all. 
 Capital is aimed to the world state all around pierced by mazes of self-sustaining income squeezing mechanisms. 
 Every One is a Pig for Someone.
[/olist]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217988/cccb71f8f5fb30189237c2ef5b20de605b9be56f.gif

You Have To
I can assure you not a single one of all Old West inhabitants experienced a roller-coaster me here is riding these last two years. Naturally, as a reward I keep getting this free-falling dread like 4 stories high stage-diving with eyes tight shut not knowing are there folks who's willing to catch or not. You stinkers better help catching or next time it could be you diving!

Chambers is Dialogue
Lately there's been lots of Eastern People spawning around. We do enjoy and approve that 100%. Losing only to artificially injected youngsters would be the worst thing.
Lots of developers these days are willing to jump into p0rno6Яaphical digital interactive entertainment projects. Are you?
How much you'd pay to be left alone?
You are welcome to spend your time here. These days it's harder to find a place where you're not welcome. That makes you special. Yes yes you.
Me here grewed and cleared six different full-blown beards while tinkering this stinker.
If you fellas won't catch my spine will hurt so much me here will remember that to the end.
The end.

notes.title: Extreme Cowboys Interactions
notes.content:
Hi there dear cowboys, Daneel's here the OG MrPinkDev! I've been asked by our publisher to write down a few words on what the hell are we gonna do with the game during it's Early Access phase.
Long story short, the priorities are like this:
1. Adding gameplay and story content like guns, equipment skills, enemy types, bosses, locations, and quests.
2. Adding some extra gameplay systems like horse racing, fishing and some others - honestly this is just 
 for [strike]meme-like update posts during the Early Access[/strike] fun
3. Tightening all the game systems closer together so different parts of the game had more affection on each other. Balancing and optimization work goes here too.

Despite all the mutations Chambers has gone through during her 2 year pre-ea dev cycle, the core is still the same - Extreme Cowboys Interactions in the Wild World of Acid Western!

Come to say hi in our Discord and be a part of development!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217988/f55e2b2bae1e847ff6ad841cc87b37895d771a5e.png

love, mrpinkdev

notes.title: Saddle Up, Partners—We’ve Got a Brand-New Demo for Ya!
notes.content:
Howdy, partners!

We’re fixin’ to make a huge announcement, and it’s a shadow drop that’ll knock yer boots off! We’ve been workin’ harder than a one-armed bandit on a poker night, and we’re proud to unveil a shiny, almost-completely-new demo version of Chambers!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217988/cccb71f8f5fb30189237c2ef5b20de605b9be56f.gif

This here demo will be part of Steam’s NEXT Fest later this month, but we’re invitin’ y’all to take an early peek. So grab yer hat, holster yer iron, and get ready to ride into a heap of new and reworked content:


 Reworked story
 New sidequests
 Tighter content
 New weapon
 "Hookshot"
 Rolling
 Card game
 Cooking
 Map system reworked
 Horse saddle bags
 New wildlife
 Ammo system
 More status effects including hunger and drunkness
 Reworked aiming
 New equipment skills
 Ability to hire folks to your protection
 Open world is reworked in favor of separated open levels
 Searching for hidden loot stashes
 Some questionable mechanics removed for a tighter experience
 Many Q&L improvements and inventory systems polish 


If ya were familiar with The Outlaw before, we’re callin’ on ya to saddle up and play the demo since it's evolved a lot. And if ya missed the previous demo, well, don’t make the same mistake twice—this one’s worth its weight in gold! 

So dust off yer spurs, partner, and get ready to ride. The frontier’s callin’, and it’s wilder than ever.

Language Updates

The demo will be updated with Chinese language support later this week. Additionally, a few languages, such as Italian, Ukrainian, and Turkish, have been translated using AI. We welcome any feedback on these translations, which can be shared in the community discussions or on our developer Discord server.

We Want to Hear from You!

If you’ve had a chance to play the demo, please consider leaving a review on Steam. Whether you loved it, have suggestions, or found areas for improvement, your input helps us shape the game into the best experience possible.
